references.text: Rimmon is also mentioned in the description of Zebulun's border, showing how Naphtali's territory bordered on Zebulun's area.
Gath-Hepher (Gittah-Hepher) is mentioned as a Levitical city given to the Merarites from the tribe of Zebulun.
Gath-Hepher is known as the hometown of the prophet Jonah, who came from this region in Zebulun.
The border description 'eastward' (kedma mizracha) uses similar directional terminology as in Moses' description of the borders of Canaan.
